info.name: Refine Feature
info.desc: Page for refining resume with template selection, preview, and full editing capabilities. All resume fields are editable with real-time server updates and formatting preservation. Optimized for mobile devices with full-screen templates and toggleable preview/editor panels.
info.tech: React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Responsive Design, Real-time Editing, i18n (react-i18next)
